name: Kisan Credit Card
summary: A credit scheme that gives farmers timely and hassle-free access to institutional credit through a Kisan Credit Card, covering crop cultivation, allied activities and consumption needs.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.
The applicant must be a farmer.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible farmer is sanctioned a credit limit of up to Rs. 3 lakh at a concessional interest rate.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the bank branch.
Final grievance before the Banking Ombudsman.
